svg.aria-label: Illustrated map of Sicily showing key locations
svg.desc: An interactive illustrated map showing 15 landmark locations across Sicily, Italy, with hand-crafted icons representing each city's cultural identity — from Palermo's beating heart to Etna's volcanic fire.

g.text: fire, snow & vineyards on its slopes
Ancient Greek theater on a cliff,
Salt windmills on the western coast,
The famous wine that bears its name,
Baroque city rebuilt from lava stone,
the elephant fountain at its heart
Gateway across the strait to Italy,
UNESCO baroque jewel split in two —
Ibla below, the modern city above
the Castello di Lombardia stands guard
palaces glowing in the Sicilian sun
